action: Anyone with a Takarakuji account should change the password, use one not used elsewhere, and check purchase and bank-account details for changes.
date_note: Unauthorised logins were on 4-5 November; the report was published 17 November.
exec: Reused passwords let attackers into thousands of customer accounts at a national lottery service and change the passwords.
org: National Local Government Lottery Administration Council (Takarakuji)
plain: Attackers used leaked passwords to log into lottery websites and apps in Japan. They got into thousands of accounts and changed most of the passwords.
summary: Security NEXT reports that Japan's Takarakuji lottery websites and apps, run by the National Local Government Lottery Administration Council, were hit by a password list attack on 4 and 5 November. Attackers logged into 4,436 accounts and changed the password on 4,133 of them. Names, contact details and the last four digits of bank and card numbers may have been seen. No purchases or bank changes were confirmed.
title: Japan's Takarakuji lottery accounts hit by password list attack

validation.note: Single Japanese trade publisher (Security NEXT) read; the council's own notice was not read.
